answer_summary: A hexadifferentiated alpha-CD has six pairwise-distinct primary substituents on an oriented six-membered cyclic scaffold. Anchoring one group leaves 5! clockwise orders, equivalently 6!/6, so the exact arrangement count is 120.
assumptions: Problem-stated alpha-CD has six alpha-D-glucopyranoside units, hence six primary CH2OH sites.
Hexadifferentiated means the six functional groups are pairwise distinct.

Cyclic rotations are identical readings of one arrangement, while reversal is not identified because the alpha-1,4-linked D-glucose ring is oriented; the source explicitly distinguishes clockwise and counterclockwise.
